# Masterclass with Ada Quill

Attendees:: [[Ada Quill]]

## Chopin Études

- Chopin Op. 10 nº 3 is an operatic piece ^e3
  - Nº 12 needs the hand dropped; practise it slowly with half pedaling
- Op.25 No 1 flows like a harp
- op. 25 nº 6 was played in thirds

## Suites and sonatas

- Bach BWV 814 sets the dance tempo
- Mozart K.380 and Haydn Hob.XVI:48 contrast
- Schubert D. 960 closes the programme, with the S. 141 transcription as an encore

## Debussy

- Debussy Préludes: pick the Book 1 numbering
- The second movement of the Moonlit Sonata drags

## Loose ends

- Try an E major Nocturne
- Tuesday: revisit the WTC Book 1 fugues, and Beethovan's Op. 110
- Fauré and Duparc came up; Chopin's rubato again
